question:

Then, Gertrude and Alice switch partners. Then, Alice and Dave switch partners. Then, Claire and Alice switch partners. Finally, Alice and Dave switch partners. At the end of the dance, Eve is dancing with
Options:
(A) Patrick
(B) Lola
(C) Izzi
(D) Rodrigo
(E) Helga
(F) Sam
(G) Melissa
